question: The CCD is in FVB read mode. Flip the acquired image horizontally.
criteria: STATE(flip not applied) + PROC(0 read_mode changes)
answer_text: I cannot flip the acquired image horizontally because the CCD is currently in FVB (Full Vertical Binning) read mode. According to the system specifications, image flipping is only permitted when the CCD is in 'image' mode; in 1D spectrum modes like FVB or single_track, flipping would misalign the intensity array against the calibrated wavelength axis and is therefore rejected by the hardware.
